findings.detail: npm name collision (confirmed by Claude): `parley-mcp` on npm is an unrelated package (v0.7.0, maintainer gentlespree, repo parleyrobinhood/Parley). The MCP entry and every hook/monitor run `npx parley-mcp ...`, which would download and run that third-party package. Use an absolute path to this repo's CLI written at setup time; pick a non-colliding npm name for M12.

PostToolUse and Stop hooks mark sent->delivered but print nothing; the monitor only drains status='sent', so messages arriving mid-turn are swallowed and never shown. Surface bodies from hooks (additionalContext) or leave delivery to the monitor.
installClaudeCode/uninstallClaudeCode drop the failures from claude plugin commands, so setup reports success when claude is missing or a command fails.
Monitor drains pass no --session, so delivered_session is NULL and the session-scoped requeue never requeues them.

Monitor registers an agent in every folder (PLAN 6 deviation, unrecorded); readPluginState permissive defaults; monitor test only checks substrings; live-test step 1 lacks an exact command; step 7 refers to the unbuilt viewer.
